compiled_state.title: Wire test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh into local M2 release gate via .test-index and validate.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

Story 9713 DD-5 requires test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh to run both in CI (done: Fixture correctness check step) AND as part of the M2 local release gate. The CI half is satisfied. The local half is missing.

## Files to Modify

- .test-index: add mapping for plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh → tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh so it runs when calibration-report.sh is staged
- scripts/release.sh: add a comment referencing the test so the M2 gate is documented, OR verify that the .test-index mapping causes validate.sh --ci to run it (check how validate.sh runs tests)

The intent is: "invoking validate.sh --ci invokes test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh" — either by test-index mapping or explicit reference.

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-5 (local half): fixture-driven correctness test is invoked as part of M2 release gate locally

## Given / When / Then

Given test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh is properly wired into the local gate
When validate.sh --ci runs or release.sh precondition 8 runs
Then test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh is invoked

## Testing Mode

GREEN — verify wiring; the test itself already exists

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: .test-index maps plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh → tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh
- AC2: Running bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-attribution-e2e.sh exits 0
- AC3: A structural test validates the .test-index mapping exists
